title: GoldenPair
description: One hand-verified (provision, date) -> text pair of the golden set (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §7 gate 5; spec #10 adds only the format). A golden set file is a JSON array of these objects; reconstruction precision is measured against indian_act_section_versions.

slug.description: The section slug, as in the sections table

as_of.description: The date the expected text was in force on

expected_text.description: The section's full text in force on as_of, as checked by hand against the source

source_url.description: The authoritative text the pair was checked against (e.g. a Gazette of India notification or an India Code version)

verified_by.description: Who hand-verified the pair: a GitHub handle, never an email address
